parent_correction_verbatim: Parent control-design correction: first-template-unit sign flip is guaranteed to change the checker-feed HASH, but NOT guaranteed to make the formula SAT or invalidate the original proof (the contradiction may not use that unit). Therefore the scientifically sound acceptance expectation is `feed binding rejects mismatched checker hash`, with native proof outcome recorded honestly; `s VERIFIED` alone on that mutated input is not necessarily a checker defect. If controls already ran under the earlier expectation, retain their FAIL/anomaly receipts and append this correction; do not relabel old expected outcomes. If not yet run, preregister this correction before them. Existing SAT+bogus-proof parent checker controls already exercise unsound proof rejection. No duplicate native run merely to repair the label.
timing: Both controls ran 2026-10-18T02:35:48-07:00 to 02:37:04-07:00 (receipts) under the expectation pre-registered in PRE-EXEC.json at 02:29:36. The correction reached the desk later, while P0-B3 ran (launched 02:52:49); the desk's nearest host-clock read was 2026-10-18T02:53:23-07:00.
policy: Receipts and logs are retained unchanged and keep their recorded verdict ANOMALY_VERIFIED under the original expectation 'not s VERIFIED'. This addendum evaluates the corrected criterion from data already recorded in those receipts and the retained checker logs. No native re-run.
corrected_criterion: feed binding rejects mismatched checker hash: the sha256 that the checker-feed writer thread measured over the bytes it actually wrote differs from the expected leaf hash (and equals the pre-registered mutant hash), so the strict per-leaf acceptance, which requires both measured feed hashes to equal the leaf hash, rejects such a run whatever the native checker prints. Native outcome recorded as observed.
